trend_vol_target.config_toml:
# Alpaca paper keys come only from APCA_API_KEY_ID / APCA_API_SECRET_KEY.
# Run near 08:45 America/New_York; previous close decides today's OPG orders.
# Live mode requires [strategy.params] equal to the certificate's selected params.
# Copy the TOML printed by fa-quant certify; then collect 20 clean Alpaca-paper
# sessions with those params. Local PaperBroker sessions do not count for live.
mode = "paper"
state_dir = "../quant-paper"

[strategy]
name = "trend_vol_target"

[universe]
symbols = ["SPY", "QQQ", "IWM", "EFA", "EEM", "TLT", "IEF", "LQD", "GLD", "DBC", "VNQ"]

[data]
provider = "yahoo"
start = "2006-02-06"
cache_dir = "../quant-cache"

[backtest]
cash_buffer = 0.02
rebalance = "weekly"
execution = "next_open"

[broker]
kind = "alpaca"
initial_cash = 100000.0

[promotion]
certificate = "../quant-paper/certificate.json"
paper_journal = "../quant-paper/journal.jsonl"
grid = [{target_vol = 0.08, max_weight = 0.25}, {target_vol = 0.08, max_weight = 0.35}, {target_vol = 0.12, max_weight = 0.25}, {target_vol = 0.12, max_weight = 0.35}]

checks.name: prob_oos_loss
checks.detail: prob_oos_loss nan fails <= 0.1: need >= 2 unique variants, finite returns and enough rows
prob_oos_loss nan fails <= 0.1: need >= 2 unique variants, finite returns and enough rows
checks.name: prob_oos_loss
